subject: Architecture selection
requested_action: Adopt C as conditional preferred concept for further engineering only
alternatives: Select C conditionally; retain current recommendation; defer; reject
technical_rationale: Minimal subject plus independent enforcement/diagnostics avoids conflating monitor with boundary; no measured ranking
evidence_basis: M00-E1D alternatives/trade and E1E decision baseline
unresolved_dependencies: No target capability or ownership proven; selection cannot certify feasibility
approval_consequence: Records concept preference only; no D2–D5 approval or implementation authority
deferral_consequence: C remains recommendation; await owner evidence

subject: Material configuration change
requested_action: Disposition the proposed separation and diagnostic-host delta; hold exact configuration approval until manifest/owner evidence exists
alternatives: Accept concept with evidence conditions; require revision; defer exact change; reject
technical_rationale: Minimal guard host/executor/hooks/plugin/start order/security/evidence roles change context and representativeness
evidence_basis: M00-E1D configuration impact, safety failures and measurement risks
unresolved_dependencies: Exact source/build/API/security/scene/resource manifest and supported platform absent
approval_consequence: Concept-only acceptance defines constraints; exact approved release still requires separately referenced complete delta
deferral_consequence: No controlled change accepted; protected files remain unchanged

subject: Claim limitations
requested_action: Adopt Class1/2/3 claim rules and prohibited-claim list as proposed interpretation constraints
alternatives: Accept limits; amend explicitly without relaxing controlled requirements; defer; reject
technical_rationale: Modified diagnostic observations must not become F00 equivalence/qualification or statistical/root-cause proof
evidence_basis: M00E1E_CLAIM_LIMITS.md; F00 source assessment; D latency characterization
unresolved_dependencies: Original requirements/approval/equivalence evidence still required for higher-class claims
approval_consequence: Constrains interpretation only; confers no data admission, equivalence, qualification or G0 closure
deferral_consequence: Maintain existing conservative inherited claim limits
explicit_exclusions: No execution, threshold change, original-cause verdict or automatic progression

subject: Evidence ownership
requested_action: Name/delegate authoritative evidence providers and reviewers for ten subsystems; authorize routing separately if desired
alternatives: Appoint scoped owners and routing; request authority records; defer; reject
technical_rationale: Contributor identity and generic admin documentation are insufficient delegation
unresolved_dependencies: Names/teams, delegation, acceptance reviewer and communication mechanism absent
approval_consequence: Only explicit signed appointments identify authority; no owner response or technical acceptance inferred
deferral_consequence: External requests remain prepared and unsent; implementation on hold
explicit_exclusions: No assumption of authority from committers/service-account/pool; no sending unless exact channel/recipients authorized

subject: Future engineering scope
requested_action: Consider a separately bounded offline detailed-design task only after preceding decisions are independently dispositioned and relevant owner evidence supports it
alternatives: Approve exact offline scope in later directive; return for narrower scope; defer; reject
technical_rationale: Need accountable owner, feasible platform and reviewable manifest before useful implementation planning
unresolved_dependencies: No defined implementation release/owner or approved D1–D4; entry checklist not satisfied
approval_consequence: A later explicit offline directive permits only listed design work; construction/deployment/observation/tests remain separate
deferral_consequence: No new detailed design or implementation work begins after E1E; collect owner records first
